description: Hourly Global ADS-B Kinematic Sensitivity Dataset (2025) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Eugene Pik (Mevocopter Aerospace). Creators Eugene PikMevocopter AerospaceContact: eugene.pik@mevocopter.com Description This Zenodo record provides both a global, hourly ADS-B kinematic sensitivity dataset and the Python and SQL code used to generate it for the 2025 calendar year. No anomaly detection, labeling, attribution, or causal inference is performed. Contents of This Release This DOI contains the following primary artifacts: 1. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
